hints.title: Half-Adder Bitwise Emulation Obstacle
hints.text: Addition without arithmetic operators requires simulating a hardware half-adder. What bitwise operations compute sum without carry and carry independently?

hints.title: Xor Sum and And Carry Invariant
hints.text: Bitwise xor computes addition without carry, while bitwise and shifted left by one produces the carry bits.

hints.title: Iterative Carry Propagation Procedure
hints.text: Iterate while carry is non-zero: calculate carry as a bitwise-and b shifted left by one, update a to a bitwise-xor b, and update b to carry. In Python, apply a 32-bit mask to manage negative two-complement overflow.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input array length or bit count
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(1) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Using + or - operators is explicitly prohibited by the problem specification.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hardware half-adder simulation terminates within at most 32 loop steps with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate must account for arbitrary precision in Python integers by masking with 0xFFFFFFFF and sign-extending.
